description: New goods vehicle and PSV operator licences granted in one publication month, from the Traffic Commissioners' weekly Applications and Decisions and Notices and Proceedings: company, licence number, licence class, traffic area, bulletin and GOV.UK link. Optionally for one traffic area. Companies and organisations are named; sole traders and partnerships are counted only.

area.description: Traffic area: slug (e.g. 'scotland', 'north-west-of-england'), letter (B, C, D, F, G, H, K, M) or name

month.description: Publication month, YYYY-MM (default: the latest month)

name: new_licences

attribution.description: Attribution text to show with the data

canonical_url.description: The human-readable HaulierScope page for this result

code.description: Traffic area letter, the second letter of the licence number (B, C, D, F, G, H, K, M)

canonical_url.description: HaulierScope page of the operator (null when the licence is not in our DVSA data)

category.description: goods = goods vehicles (HGV); psv = buses and coaches

effective_date.description: Date with effect from (surrender, termination), else the publication date

name.description: Company or organisation; sole traders and partnerships are counted, never listed

official_heading.description: The heading the licence was printed under in the publication (official wording)

publication.description: Applications and Decisions (goods) or Notices and Proceedings (PSV)

right_of_reply_url.description: Where the company can report an error or add a statement

counted_not_listed.description: Sole traders, partnerships or applicants the notice did not name: counted only

file_date.description: Date of the DVSA operator licence file the data describes (null before the first import)

markdown_url.description: Markdown version of the canonical page

retrieved_at.description: When this response was generated (ISO timestamp)

source.description: Data source(s) the result is built from

source_url.description: Where the primary source dataset is published

title: New operator licences granted
